description: The real Docker Engine on Windows, without Docker Desktop. Free for any company, terminal only.
notes: lindowin installed Docker Engine (in a WSL distro), the docker CLI and the 'lindowin' command.
Open a new terminal and try:  docker run -d -p 8080:80 nginx
Manage it with:  lindowin status | update | config | stop | uninstall

script: # lindowin sets itself up (WSL distro, Docker Engine, start task): Scoop runs its installer
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The lindowin installer did not finish. Run it again: scoop update lindowin --force' }
# 'scoop update' also runs this: keep lindowin and its settings then, remove it only on a real uninstall
